subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Name each unfinished task of the current plan and its remedy, finish or cancel, when a reopen is refused (FR-43), and cancel a task known to be wrong promptly.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Reopens are refused while the current plan's tasks run (D-19), so a task known to be wrong must be finished or cancelled first. Naming each task and the remedy keeps that wait short and explicit.
fit_criterion: A reopen of a fixture whose locked plan has one unfinished task is refused naming the task and the remedy, and proceeds once that task finishes or is cancelled.
